info.title: GauthierFitness — API Documentation
info.description:
**API REST de GauthierFitness** — boutique e-commerce de produits fitness personnalisables (vêtements, accessoires, nutrition).

## Conventions
- Authentification : **Laravel Sanctum** (`Bearer <token>`). Le token est obtenu via `POST /api/login` ou `POST /api/register`.
- Format : JSON (`Accept: application/json`).
- Codes d'erreur :
  - `401` — non authentifié
  - `403` — interdit (ex : ressource d'un autre utilisateur)
  - `404` — ressource introuvable
  - `422` — données de validation invalides
- Rate limiting : `POST /api/contact` est limité à 5 requêtes/minute/IP.

## Domaines fonctionnels
- **Auth** — inscription, connexion, déconnexion, vérification.
- **Catalogue** — produits publics (listing paginé + détail).
- **Panier & Commande** — gestion du panier, paiement Stripe, suivi commande.
- **Customisation** — sessions de personnalisation 2D/3D + assets (logos, images).
- **IA** — génération d'images via OpenAI pour designs personnalisés.
- **Admin** — produits, commandes, stocks (réservé aux administrateurs).

post.description:
Authenticates a user via email/password and returns a Sanctum token.
The previous token named "react" is revoked to limit the session to a single active device.
Creates a user account (non-admin by default) and returns a Sanctum token to authenticate immediately.

Sends an email with a reset link if an account exists for that email.
Always returns the same generic message, whether the email exists or not, to prevent
an attacker from inferring which emails are registered (OWASP A01 - user enumeration).

Verifies the token received by email and changes the password. All existing Sanctum
tokens are revoked: the user must log in again everywhere after a reset.

get.description:
Returns the authenticated user with their roles. Used by the frontend to hydrate the
store and check whether the token is still valid on application startup.

post.description: Revokes the current Sanctum token. The next call will require a new login.

get.description:
Returns active products visible in the shop. Products with variants
(color, size) are grouped: only one product per group is returned. Supports
filtering by gender, category and tag.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.description:
Returns a product with all its relations (images, categories, options, stock lots,
group variants). Used on the frontend product page.

Creates an empty cart on the fly if the user doesn't have one yet. Returns each line
with its price snapshots, variants (color/size/flavor) and any customization.

post.description:
Checks stock before adding. If a customization session is passed, it must
belong to the user and match the product; its status then moves to `added_to_cart`.
Otherwise, the existing line (same product + same option) is incremented.
post.summary: Add a product to the cart

patch.summary: Update the quantity of a cart line

delete.description: If the line references a customization session, it goes back to `ready` (released).

post.description:
Snapshots the design configuration (text, logo, colors, position) for a customizable
product. The session is then referenced by a cart line and later by an order.

patch.description:
Allows changing the configuration, the associated design, the preview image and the status.
Allowed status transitions are: `draft`, `ready`, `added_to_cart`, `ordered`.

post.description:
Stores the file in `storage/app/public/customization/logos/{user_id}/` and returns the
public URL served via the `public` disk. Used by the 2D customization editor.

Content is filtered at two levels by `OpenAIModerationService`: the prompt
is moderated **before** any generation (to avoid spending a call on an
abusive request), then the generated image is moderated **before** being stored.
On rejection, nothing is persisted except a trace in `prompt_histories`.
The target product must be customizable (`is_customizable`) and allow AI
(`allow_ai_generation`).
post.summary: Generate a design via OpenAI from a text prompt

422.description: Requête rejetée. Cas possibles : produit non customisable ou n'autorisant pas l'IA ; prompt rejeté par la modération (`reason: prompt_flagged`) ; image générée rejetée par la modération (`reason: image_flagged`). Les erreurs de validation du formulaire renvoient également un 422.

message.example: Votre demande ne respecte pas nos règles de contenu et ne peut pas être générée.

reason.description: Origine du rejet : blocklist de marque, modération du prompt, refus du générateur d’images, ou modération de l’image générée.

categories.description: Catégories de modération déclenchées (ex. violence, sexual, hate).

201.description: Design généré, validé par la modération et persisté.

503.description: Service IA (OpenAI) momentanément indisponible ou injoignable.

message.example: Le service de génération IA est temporairement indisponible. Veuillez réessayer dans un instant.

get.description:
Returns all orders of the authenticated user (most recent first), with their
associated payment and shipment.

post.description: This endpoint always returns 405. Creating an order goes through `POST /api/payment/intent`, which orchestrates the creation of the order, the Stripe payment and the shipment in a single transaction.

get.description: Verifies that the order actually belongs to the authenticated user.

post.description:
Endpoint called by Stripe (not by the frontend). Verifies the `Stripe-Signature` header
against `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, deduplicates via the `webhook_events` table (idempotency),
then processes the event:
- `payment_intent.succeeded` → marks the payment and order as paid, clears the cart,
  sends the confirmation email and decrements stock FIFO (earliest-expiring lot first).
- `payment_intent.payment_failed` → marks the payment and order as `failed`.

Full checkout cycle: validates the shipping address, computes the pre-tax/total totals from
the price snapshots, creates the order, the shipment, the order lines and a Payment
in `pending` status, then creates a Stripe PaymentIntent in EUR. The returned `client_secret`
lets the frontend confirm the payment client-side. The final status is updated by the webhook
`POST /api/stripe/webhook`.
post.summary: Create a Stripe PaymentIntent for the current cart

post.description:
Sends an email to the configured support address (`mail.support_address`). This endpoint
is **rate-limited to 5 requests/minute per IP** to limit abuse.

get.description: Includes inactive products and supports search/filtering. Fixed pagination at 20/page.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
The slug is derived from the name and automatically deduplicated (`-N` suffix on
conflict). Options (size, format, capacity) can be passed in a single request.

patch.description: All fields are optional (`sometimes`). The slug cannot be changed here.

delete.description: Soft-deletes if the model uses `SoftDeletes`. Existing orders keep their snapshot.

patch.description: Toggles the `is_active` value. Returns the final state.

get.description:
Aggregates products, orders (total revenue, monthly revenue, by status), stock (out of
stock, low stock). Used by the admin panel home dashboard.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

patch.description:
Triggers notification emails (`OrderStatusUpdated`) for transitions to
`shipped`, `delivered`, `canceled`. Each email is sent only once (idempotency
via `*_email_sent_at`).

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of products (25/page) with the sum of their lot quantities
(`stock_qty`). Search by name/SKU is supported.
get.summary: Global stock view: all products with their total quantity

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.description:
Returns lots grouped into two blocks: `global_stock` (lots without an option) and
`option_stocks` (lots per variant). Lots are sorted FIFO (nearest expiration first).

post.description:
Logs the stock entry in `stock_movements` with `type=in`. The expiration date must be
strictly in the future (or null for non-perishable products).

patch.description:
Computes the delta (`new_quantity - old_quantity`) and logs the difference in
`stock_movements` with `type=correction` and the provided reason. Used to handle
breakage, inventory counts, or error corrections.

get.description:
Returns all `stock_movements` (in, out, corrections) linked to the product,
30 per page, most recent first.
get.summary: Paginated history of a product's stock movements
